items.raw_excerpt: People in Ilkley and Birstall share their frustrations at the loss of tip facilities.
items.summary_en: People in Ilkley and Birstall are frustrated after losing their local waste tip facilities. They now have to travel long distances to dispose of their waste.
items.summary_ko: Ilkley와 Birstall 주민들은 지역 쓰레기장 폐쇄에 불만을 나타내고 있다. 이제 쓰레기를 버리기 위해 먼 거리를 이동해야 한다.
items.title_en: Communities travel miles to drop off waste
items.title_ko: Ilkley와 Birstall 주민들이 먼 거리를 이동해 쓰레기를 버리고 있다
items.title_original: The communities travelling miles to dispose of waste

items.raw_excerpt: The celebration will happen from Sep 29 to Oct 11 across numerous Japanese brands at Takashimaya, including Bandai, Casio, Fujifilm, Sanrio and more.
items.summary_en: Takashimaya Singapore will mark 60 years of Japan and Singapore ties. The celebration runs from Sep 29 to Oct 11. Many Japanese brands will sell special items and run a food fair.
items.summary_ko: 타카시마야 싱가포르가 일본과 싱가포르의 관계 60주년을 기념한다. 축제는 9월 29일부터 10월 11일까지 열린다. 일본üz 여러 브랜드가 한정 상품 판매와 음식 행사를 진행한다.
items.title_original: Takashimaya to celebrate 60 years of Singapore-Japan diplomatic ties with exclusive items, food fair and more

items.raw_excerpt: The more I think about it and the more research I do, the more I realise we really have some weird habits.
items.summary_en: The article explores some of the unusual and amusing habits of Dutch people. These little cultural quirks make for an interesting read.
items.summary_ko: 이 글은 네덜란드 사람들의 독특하고 재미있는 습관들을 살펴본다. 이런 소소한 문화적 특색은 꽤 흥미롭다.
items.title_original: The Dutch and some of their quirky habits

items.raw_excerpt: Pope Leo on Monday arrived in a French border city to speak on the future of Europe, giving a distinctly political dimension to a landmark visit to France that has sparked scenes of spiritual jubilation.
items.summary_en: Pope Leo arrived in the French border city of Metz on Monday. He will speak about the future of Europe. The visit is political as well as spiritual.
items.summary_ko: 레오 교황이 월요일 프랑스 국경 도시 메츠에 도착했습니다. 그는 유럽의 미래에 대해 연설할 예정입니다. 이번 방문은 종교적 의미뿐 아니라 정치적 성격도 함께 갖고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Pope Leo Visits Metz to Talk About United Europe
items.title_ko: 레오 교황, 유럽 통합을 이야기하며 메츠 도착
items.title_original: Pope heads to French city of Metz to speak on united Europe

items.raw_excerpt: Most young people leaving home in the Netherlands head to Amsterdam, according to new figures from national statistics office CBS. More than 174,000 people aged 18 to 30 moved out of their parents’ home in 2024, and a third of them settled in Amsterdam, one of ten councils tracked by the research. The city drew 12,760, well ahead of Rotterdam and Groningen. The city was also the most popular destination for students, attracting 5,475, followed by Utrecht and Groningen. Nijmegen...
items.summary_en: Dutch statistics show that 174,000 people aged 18 to 30 moved out of their parents' home in 2024. One third of them went to Amsterdam. Rotterdam and Groningen came next, and Amsterdam was also the top choice for students.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 통계청 자료에 따르면 2024년에 부모 집을 떠난 18~30세는 17만 4천여 명이었다. 이 중 3분의 1은 암스테르담으로 옮겨갔다. 로테르담과 흐로닝엔이 그 뒤를 이었으며, 학생이 가장 많이 모이는 도시도 암스테르담이었다.
items.title_en: Amsterdam is the top place for young people leaving home
items.title_ko: 부모 집을 떠난 20대, 최다 목적지는 암스테르담
items.title_original: Amsterdam top destination for young people leaving home

items.raw_excerpt: A controversial proposed data centre has been withdrawn by its developer after it became a flashpoint amid growing opposition to the AI infrastructure development across the country.
items.summary_en: A developer has withdrawn plans for a data centre in Sydney after strong opposition from local residents. The project had become a flashpoint due to growing concerns about its impact on the community.
items.summary_ko: 개발업체가 시드니 레인 코브 지역 데이터 센터 건설 계획을 지역 주민들의 강한 반대에 따라 철회했습니다. 해당 프로젝트는 지역사회에 미칠 영향에 대한 우려로 논란이 됐습니다.
items.title_en: Sydney data centre plans withdrawn after community opposition
items.title_ko: 시드니 데이터 센터 계획, 지역 주민 반대로 철회
items.title_original: Controversial Sydney data centre project pulled amid community anger
